items.title: Rockwell Automation (ROK) Unveils PanelView Pro For Easier Factory HMI Upgrades
items.summary: Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) has introduced its new PanelView Pro industrial visualization terminal for manufacturers upgrading human machine interfaces. The PanelView Pro is aimed at helping facilities modernize aging systems while keeping production lines running with limited disruption. Key features include higher performance, hardened hardware for factory environments, added cybersecurity capabilities, and a modular design for lifecycle management.
